chunks.text: I’m going to be bouncing between Shenzhen and Shanghai soon, so I’ve been keeping an eye on places in Shenzhen for dinner and what’s happening in Shanghai sports-wise.
For that Shenzhen night out, I’m set on Din Tai Fung Shenzhen — it just feels like the safest crowd-pleaser for everyone.
It’s happening on 2026-05-03, and we’re aiming for 20:00 so nobody has to rush after work.
There’ll be 6 of us, and it’s under Tang Xue — her number is 13822334455 in case the restaurant needs to reach someone.
Then in Shanghai I’m planning to catch that CSL match, Shanghai Port vs Shandong Taishan — and we’re sitting in the Away Stand.

I’m grabbing 4 tickets, under Mason White — phone 13888990011 — and the ID number on file is 330102199708085678, and honestly I also need to swing by a pharmacy because I’ve been feeling a bit off lately, like maybe I should check what medicine to take…
